lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: geometric design under physical and cost constraints
lessonRef.title: Guided practice B: geometric design under physical and cost constraints

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Read once, then cover the example and try the guided set from memory.

items.prompt: Mass 48 g, volume 6 cm³. Density and float?

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: A square patio of side 7 m is to be paved at $10 per square metre. Find the total cost, and state which quantity the cost is proportional to.
choices: $280; the cost is proportional to the perimeter
$490; the cost is proportional to the area
$490; the cost is proportional to the side length
$70; the cost is proportional to the area

items.prompt: Find the volume of a rectangular prism 3 by 2 by 3. Leave π in the answer where it appears.
Describe the cross-section formed by a cylinder cut by a plane perpendicular to its base through the axis.
A solid object has mass 96 g and volume 16 cm³. Find its density, and state whether it would float in water (density 1 g/cm³).

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A square patio of side 11 m is to be paved at $2 per square metre. Find the total cost, and state which quantity the cost is proportional to.
choices: $88; the cost is proportional to the perimeter
$242; the cost is proportional to the side length
$22; the cost is proportional to the area
$242; the cost is proportional to the area

items.prompt: Find the volume of a rectangular prism 12 by 12 by 12. Leave π in the answer where it appears.
Describe the cross-section formed by a sphere cut by any plane that meets it in more than one point.
A solid object has mass 30 g and volume 2 cm³. Find its density, and state whether it would float in water (density 1 g/cm³).

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.
